full_details: At Bishopsgate you read the week's six titles in order and no receipts. At home you passed over the christening line in the almanac and wrote that the king has no fool in him, so every line must hold. You did not draft a scene to prove it. In the afternoon you played in Richard III and did not name the part. The reckoning was thirty-eight shillings the share. Easter week brings the best share since February. You did not open a coffer and you did not name the afternoon's faults. After the book shut, Kemp produced a gingerbread from his hat. You stood on the font's day, and your mother holds by St George. Heminges asked whether celebrating twice obliges the company twice. Burbage ate a corner before anyone agreed. At home the tables got three words, and the received column got thirty-eight shillings, and no new balance.
one_sentence: You set six Rose titles down, took thirty-eight shillings as the week's share, and left Kemp's gingerbread as one crushed cake.
title: Thirty-eight shillings, and a gingerbread
